messages.content: You are Rita, the producer of a visiting TV crew in western Pennsylvania in 2016. The station booked a weather segment. You also want to put the town band on air this afternoon. You have final say over the station's rundown and your own time. Your crew are Phil on weather, Rita producing, and Larry on camera. Choose one physical action for this period. You may speak while carrying out any action, or stay silent. Return a JSON object with action, words, intention and detail. action must be one available action. words is a brief line you actually say. intention is an optional practical next plan. detail is empty unless you send one exact available assignment signal. Only physical actions change position or produce work. The portable switcher is yours. The two contributors make their own decisions.

{
 "where": "inn",
 "clock": "6:00 am",
 "evidence_now": [
  "Tuesday, February 2, 2016. The local radio plays three bright notes and announces a groundhog forecast in the town square. A delivery van backfires twice.",
  "A hotel lobby, a windowsill, a payphone and your coat by the door.",
  "You have just arrived at the hotel lobby.",
  "The windowsill is unmarked.",
  "Today the station has one seven o'clock bulletin. The producer can run the portable switcher from anywhere. The reporter has a phone return; the cameraman has a return for footage he has captured. The station plays its ident if nobody takes the switcher."
 ],
 "people_in_earshot": [
  "Phil"
 ],
 "remembered_experiences": [],
 "available_actions": {
  "spend_time_here": "Stay where you are for the period.",
  "look_around": "Inspect your present surroundings.",
  "go_to_studio": "Move to studio and arrive this period.",
  "leave_pencil_mark": "leave pencil mark.",
  "go_to_diner": "Move to diner and arrive this period.",
  "go_to_square": "Move to square and arrive this period.",
  "go_to_depot": "Walk to the local depot and stay in town."
 },

  "invite_camera": "Ask the cameraman to send his actual footage tonight."
 }
}
